name: Comfort The Dying
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate source of comfort and strength for those facing death, as He is near to the brokenhearted and upholds His people with His righteous hand. The Psalmist expresses confidence in the Lord's presence even in the valley of the shadow of death, finding solace in His guidance and protection. Additionally, the death of God's saints is precious to Him, affirming His sovereign care and eternal provision. Believers are encouraged not to fear or be dismayed, for God promises to strengthen and help them in their final moments.
